title: Office Lease (Full-Service Gross): The Marlinspike Building, Suite 640
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Late charge of 15 percent of full monthly rent, plus interest
defects.why: Any late installment, however small, triggers an immediate charge of 15 percent of the entire monthly base rent, on top of default interest. A charge that does not vary with the amount overdue is hard to defend as a reasonable estimate of the landlord's administrative cost.
quotes: a late charge equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the full Monthly Base Rent then in effect, whatever the amount of the installment that is late

defects.title: Deposit held until 60 days after the year-end reconciliation
defects.why: The landlord keeps the deposit after surrender and returns it 60 days after it delivers the operating expense reconciliation for the year the term ends, which can be many months after it gets possession. The deposit must be returned no later than 30 days from the date the landlord receives possession.
quotes: shall return the balance to Tenant within sixty (60) days after Landlord delivers the Reconciliation Statement for the calendar year in which the Term ends

defects.title: Lease declines to state CASp inspection status and has tenant waive it
defects.why: The accessibility section says the landlord makes no statement on whether the premises have had a Certified Access Specialist inspection and has the tenant waive the statement and any related notice. Every commercial lease must state whether a CASp inspection has occurred and, if no certificate has been issued, include the statutory notice.
quotes: Landlord makes no statement in this Lease as to whether the Premises have or have not undergone inspection by a Certified Access Specialist, and Tenant waives any right to receive such a statement or any related notice from Landlord.

defects.title: $2,000 per day liquidated damages for a late estoppel certificate
defects.why: The tenant owes $2,000 for every day an estoppel certificate is late, whether or not any sale or loan is pending or delayed. A fixed daily sum with no link to likely loss may have been unreasonable when the lease was made.
quotes: as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, the sum of $2,000 for each day after the tenth day until the certificate is delivered

defects.title: Section 1951.4 remedy while transfer rights are suspended
defects.why: The lease invokes the section 1951.4 continuation remedy, but says that while the landlord uses it the assignment article does not apply, the tenant has no right to assign or sublet, and the landlord may refuse any transferee without regard to reasonableness. The remedy is available only if the tenant may sublet or assign subject at most to reasonable standards or consent not unreasonably withheld.
quotes: Article 15 shall not apply, Tenant shall have no right to assign this Lease or sublet the Premises, and Landlord may refuse any proposed assignee or subtenant without regard to whether the refusal is reasonable

defects.title: Pre-dispute jury trial waiver
defects.why: The parties waive jury trial in the lease itself, before any dispute exists. A jury may be waived only in the ways listed in subdivision (f), and a contract clause signed before a dispute is not one of them.
quotes: Landlord and Tenant each knowingly and voluntarily waive the right to a trial by jury in any action, proceeding or counterclaim brought by either of them against the other
